description: A simple script to wait for other docker images to be started while using docker-compose (or Kubernetes or docker stack or whatever)

summary.one_liner: A small Rust command-line utility that makes a container wait for TCP ports, local paths, or a fixed time before starting its main command, commonly used with docker-compose.
summary.what_it_does: The utility waits until a list of host:port pairs accept TCP connections, until listed local files or directories exist, or for a fixed number of seconds, and then runs a configured command. Configuration is through environment variables such as WAIT_HOSTS, WAIT_PATHS, WAIT_COMMAND, WAIT_TIMEOUT, and WAIT_SLEEP_INTERVAL. It can sleep before checking and after everything is ready. Logging verbosity is set with WAIT_LOGGER_LEVEL. When used with WAIT_COMMAND and an exec-form ENTRYPOINT, it replaces its own process with the target command, so it works in images without a shell. The README says it has no dependencies on Docker and can be used anywhere.
use_cases: make an app container wait for its database before starting
delay startup until a dependent service port is open in docker-compose
wait for a file or directory to appear before launching a process
start a scratch or distroless container after a dependency is ready
add startup ordering to Kubernetes or docker stack deployments
cross-compile a small wait binary for arm devices
how_to_run: Set WAIT_HOSTS: postgres:5432, mysql:3306 in the service environment in docker-compose.yml
notable: Waits on TCP ports, file/directory existence, or fixed sleep time, configurable via environment variables
Can exec into the target command so it works in scratch or distroless images with no shell
Prebuilt executables for x86_64, aarch64 and arm7 Linux, built with MUSL
No external runtime dependencies; a plain cargo build produces the binary
caveats: Building for other targets requires Rust toolchain and, for cross-compilation, the Cross tool and a working Docker setup
Prebuilt binaries are described as Linux only; other platforms need a source build
Checks are only TCP reachability and file existence; it does not check application health beyond that
